summary: Use this page when the property already knows it runs on a Saflok estate and needs a faster path to compatible hotel card samples, material choices and pre-encoding discussion.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
Hotels refreshing Saflok room-key stock without broad platform change. Properties validating card material upgrades after baseline compatibility is understood.

faq.question: What helps a Saflok card request move fastest?
faq.answer: A current guest card sample or a clear Saflok lock reference usually shortens the path to a realistic sample set the most.

faq.question: Should the property choose premium materials first?
faq.answer: Usually no. Start with baseline compatibility, then move into material upgrades once the card path is already proven.
